about_short_description.short_description: Synapsica offers a radiology workflow solution for radiologists to automate spine reporting and patient care.

product.name: Spindle
product.description: An AI reporting assistant for MRI spine that automates spine measurements and pathology characterization to generate standardized reports.

product.name: SpindleX
product.description: An AI reporting assistant for stress X-rays of the spine that automates quantification of spinal abnormalities and injury features.

product.name: RADIOLens PACS
product.description: An AI-enabled Picture Archiving and Communication System (PACS) that manages medical imaging workflows with fast image upload/download and automated reporting features.

product.name: Teleradiology Services
product.description: Remote radiology reporting services providing preliminary and secondary reads with subspecialty expertise to reduce turnaround time and reporting costs.
